api_credential_name_valid.name: api_credential_name_valid
api_credential_name_valid.value: char_length("api_credential"."name") between 1 and 100 and "api_credential"."name" = btrim("api_credential"."name") and "api_credential"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

api_credential_revocation_consistent.name: api_credential_revocation_consistent
api_credential_revocation_consistent.value: ("api_credential"."revoked_at" is null and "api_credential"."revoked_by_user_id" is null) or ("api_credential"."revoked_at" is not null and "api_credential"."revoked_by_user_id" is not null)

project_invitation_lifecycle_consistent.name: project_invitation_lifecycle_consistent
project_invitation_lifecycle_consistent.value: ("project_invitation"."status" in ('pending', 'expired') and "project_invitation"."accepted_at" is null and "project_invitation"."accepted_by_user_id" is null and "project_invitation"."revoked_at" is null and "project_invitation"."revoked_by_user_id" is null) or ("project_invitation"."status" = 'accepted' and "project_invitation"."accepted_at" is not null and "project_invitation"."accepted_by_user_id" is not null and "project_invitation"."revoked_at" is null and "project_invitation"."revoked_by_user_id" is null) or ("project_invitation"."status" = 'revoked' and "project_invitation"."accepted_at" is null and "project_invitation"."accepted_by_user_id" is null and "project_invitation"."revoked_at" is not null and "project_invitation"."revoked_by_user_id" is not null)

project_membership_removal_consistent.name: project_membership_removal_consistent
project_membership_removal_consistent.value: ("project_membership"."removed_at" is null and "project_membership"."removed_by_user_id" is null) or ("project_membership"."removed_at" is not null and "project_membership"."removed_by_user_id" is not null)

project_locale_tag_valid.name: project_locale_tag_valid
project_locale_tag_valid.value: char_length("project_locale"."tag") between 1 and 64 and "project_locale"."tag" = btrim("project_locale"."tag") and "project_locale"."tag" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]+(-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$'

project_locale_position_consistent.name: project_locale_position_consistent
project_locale_position_consistent.value: ("project_locale"."status" = 'removed' and "project_locale"."position" is null) or ("project_locale"."status" in ('enabled', 'disabled') and "project_locale"."position" >= 0)

audit_event_environment_scope_complete.name: audit_event_environment_scope_complete
audit_event_environment_scope_complete.value: "audit_event"."environment_id" is null or "audit_event"."project_id" is not null

environment_name_valid.name: environment_name_valid
environment_name_valid.value: char_length("environment"."name") between 1 and 100 and "environment"."name" = btrim("environment"."name") and "environment"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

project_name_valid.name: project_name_valid
project_name_valid.value: char_length("project"."name") between 1 and 100 and "project"."name" = btrim("project"."name") and "project"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

project_archive_fields_consistent.name: project_archive_fields_consistent
project_archive_fields_consistent.value: ("project"."archived_at" is null and "project"."archived_by_user_id" is null) or ("project"."archived_at" is not null and "project"."archived_by_user_id" is not null)

workspace_name_valid.name: workspace_name_valid
workspace_name_valid.value: char_length("workspace"."name") between 1 and 100 and "workspace"."name" = btrim("workspace"."name") and "workspace"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

workspace_membership_revocation_consiste.name: workspace_membership_revocation_consistent
workspace_membership_revocation_consiste.value: ("workspace_membership"."revoked_at" is null and "workspace_membership"."revoked_by_user_id" is null) or ("workspace_membership"."revoked_at" is not null and "workspace_membership"."revoked_by_user_id" is not null)
